headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: June 16, 2026**
article:
The Philadelphia Phillies dominated the Miami Marlins, securing an 8-2 victory behind Jesús Luzardo's strong performance. The Washington Nationals took down the Kansas City Royals 6-4, with Paxton Schultz earning the win and Gus Varland notching the save. The Toronto Blue Jays secured a 6-1 victory over the Boston Red Sox, led by George Springer's impressive performance at the plate.

Several players have been impacted by injuries, affecting their team's roster. The Seattle Mariners have placed third baseman Will Wilson on the 60-day injured list, while left fielder Randy Arozarena has been placed on the 10-day injured list with a left hamstring strain. The Philadelphia Phillies have placed right-handed pitcher Brad Keller on the 15-day injured list due to right forearm tendinitis.

The Kansas City Royals made a trade with the Toronto Blue Jays, acquiring right-handed pitcher Connor Seabold in exchange for right-hander Denis Samudio and cash. The Seattle Mariners traded right-handed pitcher Yosver Zulueta to the Chicago Cubs for cash. The Cleveland Guardians traded right fielder Nolan Jones and cash to the Chicago White Sox for future considerations.

top_news.title: **Phillies Rout Marlins 8-2**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies dominated the Miami Marlins, securing an 8-2 victory. Jesús Luzardo led the Phillies to the win, pitching 7.0 innings with 9 strikeouts and 2 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Nationals Take Down Royals 6-4**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals secured a 4-6 victory over the Kansas City Royals, with Paxton Schultz earning the win and Gus Varland notching the save. Curtis Mead led the Royals' offense with a home run and three RBIs.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays Take Down Red Sox 6-1**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays secured a 6-1 victory over the Boston Red Sox, led by George Springer's impressive performance at the plate. Springer hit a home run and drove in three runs, while Dylan Cease earned the win with 5 strong innings of work.

top_news.title: **Yankees Rout White Sox 12-2**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees dominated the Chicago White Sox, securing a 12-2 victory. José Caballero led the White Sox offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Mariners Place Will Wilson on 60-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: The Seattle Mariners have made a roster move, placing third baseman Will Wilson on the 60-day injured list. This change is effective as of June 16, 2026.

top_news.title: **Royals Acquire Connor Seabold in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals made a move on June 15, 2026, acquiring right-handed pitcher Connor Seabold from the Toronto Blue Jays in exchange for right-hander Denis Samudio and cash.
